L. 90–537, title III, § 307, Sept. 30, 1968, 82 Stat. 893, reauthorized this project for construction and provided for integration and participation of this project in Lower Colorado River Basin Development Fund. Section 616bb, Pub. L. 88–565, § 2, Sept. 2, 1964, 78 Stat. 848, related to protection of downstream water users against impairment of water quality from operations of this project and to indemnification. L. 88–565, § 4, Sept. 2, 1964, 78 Stat. 848, related to establishment of a conservancy district or similar organization prior to construction of this project. Section 616ee, Pub. L. 88–565, § 5, Sept. 2, 1964, 78 Stat. 848, related to interest rate, repayment of construction costs and period for repayment. Section 616ff, Pub.
